criteria.criterion: DiscoveryStagePlan and DiscoveryStageResult represent stable unit identity, dependencies, blocking capability, usage, and all six outcome kinds without gate-specific verdict fields.
The discovery contracts live in a new `rebar.llm.review_kernel.discovery` submodule with additive `__init__` exports and no change to the existing `verify`/`decide`/`coach`/`verify_models` symbols.
Given one exhausted local failure, the real executor retains earlier successes, executes later independent units, and marks dependent units skipped with the missing dependency id.

Given a systemic initialization/configuration failure or cancellation, the executor stops scheduling new work and returns exact completed, failed, and cancelled accounting without fabricating usage or findings; a unit whose non-interruptible call was already dispatched when cancellation is observed commits as its true `success`/`failed` outcome with real usage; a not-yet-dispatched unit is `cancelled`.

A positive explicit budget deterministically sheds work that does not fit — in ascending (dependency rank, unit id) order so the shed set is identical across runs; omission is uncapped and zero is rejected rather than interpreted as disablement.
The versioned envelope round-trips only digest-complete, content-identical success/resume records; injected failed, cancelled, skipped, shed, corrupt, and legacy envelopes stay missing.
Stored trace serialization contains normalized outcome metadata and lineage but no raw prompt, ticket/context body, provider payload, or secret, and public review result schemas remain unchanged.
Fault-injection tests prove restoration plus a clean rerun succeeds and unrelated success state is unchanged.
